one_month_reasoning: One scheduled event falls in the window: Q3 2026 results, which a third-party calendar lists for about 2026-11-05 (IonQ had not confirmed the date as of 2026-10-14; Q3 2025 was reported on 2025-11-05). It will be the first quarter with SkyWater consolidated (2 months). Expect revenue at or above the implied run-rate, since IonQ has beaten its revenue guidance quarter after quarter (Q2 $80.1M vs a $280-290M FY guide). The risks are a wider adjusted-EBITDA loss (Q2 -$120.3M), the first combined-company margins and any FY2027 framing. In recent quarters a beat has not stopped the selling: the stock fell ~43% from late May to late August after a record Q2. The stock sits near its $25.89 52-week low, with short interest ~10.7% of float, so a squeeze on a beat is possible, as is a breakdown on any guidance wobble. With no clear directional edge, I centre slightly below spot (median ~$30.8, about -2%, reflecting negative momentum and the martingale median drag at high vol) and use ~27% one-month vol (92%/3.5 = 26% plus a little for earnings).

bear.story: 256-qubit and 10,000-qubit milestones slip a year or more; the sector de-rating continues (Quantinuum, Rigetti); an equity raise at low prices; Wolfpack-type government-funding questions return when DoD appropriations run late. The price converges on intrinsic value (cash + ops + a small option).

base.story: Revenue meets the $450-460M guide and grows ~80% in FY2027 with SkyWater. Burn stays near $0.5B a year. The 256-qubit system is commissioned in 2027 without logical-qubit proof at scale. The speculative premium decays by about half.

bull.story: Convincing 256-qubit and logical-qubit demonstrations, DARPA QBI progress, federal quantum funding after the executive orders, and a sector rally: the market re-rates IonQ to its early-2026 premium.

comps_summary.peer_range: NTM P/E 17.8x (IBM) to 22.0x (HON); NTM EV/EBITDA 12.4x to 14.8x; EV/sales 3.83x (IBM NTM) to 325.7x (QBTS TTM). The quantum pure plays (RGTI, QBTS, QUBT) have no meaningful earnings or EBITDA multiples.
comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: P/E and EV/EBITDA cannot be applied (IonQ TTM EBITDA -$852M, F81). The 8.0x NTM EV/sales sanity check sits inside the 3.8x-326x range and carries only 5% weight. The 22x NOPAT exit multiple in the 2035 success states is the top of the IBM/HON NTM P/E range.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: No premium is applied. There are fewer than 10 genuine listed comparables: only 3 listed quantum pure plays have filings data, plus IBM and Honeywell (Quantinuum's parent); Quantinuum (QNT) listed in June 2026 and is used as a transaction mark, not a multiple. That is why peer multiples are only a cross-check here, as Kilian's IonQ instruction requires.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$12.6 the market would value IonQ's computing platform at under ~$2B (431M x $12.6 = $5.4B + $0.4B warrants - $1.9B net cash - $1.9B operating businesses), less than IonQ itself paid for Oxford Ionics plus Lightsynq ($1.9B). Getting there in 12 months would most likely mean a fundamental break: a failed or abandoned 256-qubit or 10,000-qubit program, a large discounted equity raise, a government-contract or accounting finding (Wolfpack's allegations confirmed), or a rival modality decisively demonstrating fault tolerance. My bearish view would then have been right for the wrong reason, or something worse than I modelled has happened.

catalysts.event: Q3 2026 results: first quarter with SkyWater consolidated; combined margins; any FY2027 framing
Q4/FY2026 results and the first full-year combined-company guidance (FY2027 revenue and adjusted EBITDA)
FY2027 U.S. defense appropriations / continuing resolutions; funding of quantum programs and earmarks (the core of the Wolfpack thesis)
Commissioning of the 256-qubit system and the 12-logical-qubit milestone (roadmap: 2026, already slipping into 2027)
Roadmap target of a 10,000-physical-qubit, 800-logical-qubit chip; a visible slip would test the premium
Possible equity raise or ATM as cash falls toward ~$1.3B against ~$0.5B a year of burn
Rival milestones (Quantinuum, IBM, Google, PsiQuantum) and quantum-sector sentiment (QNT -44% from IPO price)

key_uncertainties: Whether the trapped-ion roadmap scales: 256 qubits (2026, slipping to 2027) to 10,000 qubits (2027) to 2M qubits (2030) is a 4-orders-of-magnitude jump with no track record at scale.

Defense/intelligence exposure: IonQ does not disclose a defense or intelligence revenue share. U.S. government customers were ~40% of Q2 2026 revenue (derived: the company says ~60% was commercial, defined as non-U.S.-government; src 10), and under 40% of FY2025 revenue (more than 60% commercial; src 12). Defense and intelligence are a subset of that, alongside DOE and others. Wolfpack alleges up to 86% of 2022-2024 revenue came from Pentagon earmarks (disputed by IonQ; src 14, 31). SkyWater (DMEA Trusted Foundry) and Capella (mostly U.S. government per src 14) raise the post-2026 share, but neither is quantified.
How fast the speculative premium decays: the market implies ~$10.8B for the computing platform vs my $0.8-7.0B.
Quality and repeatability of revenue: one-off system sales and two customers at 33% of Q2 revenue (src 8). SkyWater depends on Infineon (43% of its 2025 revenue, src 22).
The size of the next equity raise and the price it comes at; the dilutive SkyWater, Oxford Ionics and other stock deals already done.
Litigation and regulatory outcome of the Wolfpack allegations (Ademi investigation announced; no 2026 class action found).

reverse_dcf_check: At $31.545 the market capitalizes IonQ at $13.59B (430.8M diluted shares) + $0.92B of private-warrant value - ~$1.87B net cash (mid-Oct est.) - $1.87B of operating businesses = ~$10.8B for the computing platform. At 15% to 2035 plus ~$2B of further funding, that needs a 2035 EV of ~$41B: ~$2.1B NOPAT at 22x, or ~$13B revenue at a 20% EBIT margin (HON 21.7%). That is 18-47% of McKinsey's $28-72B 2035 QC market, compared with IonQ's ~$0.3B organic FY2026 guide. It requires P(leader) of about 0.7 in my tree vs the 0.18 I assign. Turned into value: the gap is ~$18-19 per share of speculative premium, which I expect to decay by about half over 12 months (base case $24) rather than vanish. The engine's standard DCF (-$3.47/sh, FY2030 EBIT margin -25%) and its implied WACC of 4.1% for the EV/sales leg are not meaningful for a business with negative terminal cash flow, which is why dcf_weight = 0.

sbc_treatment.note: FY2025 SBC $312.0M (F43); TTM $450.0M (F46); Q2 2026 $131.5M. To the horizon, SBC is counted only as dilution: shares +5% (430.8M to 452.3M), and the cash path excludes SBC (TTM FCF -$483.9M, F82). After the horizon, success-state values use GAAP margins (after SBC, HON reference) and add no further share growth. The engine's DCF leg would double count but carries 0 weight.

reasoning: Lane: skeptic. (1) What the market pays for: $13.6B market cap (430.8M diluted shares incl. 24.1M SkyWater shares, RSUs and PSUs) against ~$1.9B net cash pro forma for SkyWater, TTM revenue $246.5M, TTM operating loss -$1.0B and TTM SBC $450M. Strip out cash and the acquired businesses and the market pays ~$10.8B for the computing option, more than Quantinuum's whole market EV (~$7B at $33.75) and above PsiQuantum's $7B private mark. (2) Bear evidence weighed: Wolfpack (Feb 2026) alleges up to 86% of 2022-24 revenue came from cancelled Pentagon earmarks, bookings inflated by $54.6M and $396.6M of insider sales. These are disputed and unadjudicated, so they enter only as scenario probability, not as a revenue haircut. Firmer red flags: two customers were 33% of Q2 revenue; the Q2 net loss of -$1.87B was mostly a -$1.65B warrant mark that the non-GAAP figures add back; 79M private warrants at $99.88/$155 cap the upside to 2032; and acquisitions are serially paid in stock (Oxford $1.59B, Capella $425M, SkyWater 24M shares + $741M). SkyWater adds foundry revenue with 43% Infineon concentration, and most of the raised $450-460M guide comes from it. The 2026 roadmap step (256 qubits, 12 logical qubits) is slipping into 2027. Morgan Stanley cut its target to $35 (Hold) in Feb 2026. The stock fell 43% from late May to late August even after a record quarter. Positives credited: revenue beats, 99.99% 2-qubit fidelity, DARPA QBI Stage B, no debt. Insider selling is not currently heavy: the CEO's Sept 2026 Form 4 is tax withholding only. (3) Valuation: four methods give $7.7-21.4 per share; fair value $12.83. (4) Price forecast: fair value is not the 12-month price. Quantum pure plays have kept a premium to fundamentals for years, so the base case has the premium decay by about half ($24), the bear case is convergence to intrinsic value ($11) and the bull case is a re-rating ($55). That gives a mixture median of ~$22 and a mean of ~$26 (-17% vs spot). I blend this 50/50 with a lognormal (median $22.5, sigma 0.85, near the 92% realized vol) so the ladder is not lumpy. A high-vol martingale already has a median ~35% below spot, so P(>= spot $31.5) = 0.31 is decisive but not extreme. Defense/intelligence revenue share: not disclosed; U.S. government ~40% of Q2 2026 revenue (derived from ~60% commercial = non-U.S.-government), under 40% for FY2025; defense/intel is a subset. Research limits: sec.gov refused curl with a generic User-Agent, so filings were read with WebFetch; Twelve Data statistics and estimates need a paid plan and were skipped; the Wolfpack report itself and DataCenterDynamics were not reachable (403); X and Reddit were not used.

bear.story: 256-qubit and 10,000-qubit milestones slip a year or more; the sector de-rating continues (Quantinuum, Rigetti); an equity raise at low prices; Wolfpack-type government-funding questions return when DoD appropriations run late. The price converges on intrinsic value (cash + ops + a small option).

base.story: Revenue meets the $450-460M guide and grows ~80% in FY2027 with SkyWater. Burn stays near $0.5B a year. The 256-qubit system is commissioned in 2027 without logical-qubit proof at scale. The speculative premium decays by about half.

bull.story: Convincing 256-qubit and logical-qubit demonstrations, DARPA QBI progress, federal quantum funding after the executive orders, and a sector rally: the market re-rates IonQ to its early-2026 premium.

model_inputs.structure_note: The standard DCF cannot describe IonQ: EBIT is deeply negative through FY2030 (TTM operating loss -$1,006M, F13), so a Gordon or exit terminal on FY2030 is negative and meaningless. dcf_weight = 0. The years carry an indicative revenue path only (FY2026 guidance, then SkyWater full year plus organic growth). Value sits in four custom legs (rNPV, TAM, cash+option, SOTP/transaction marks) and a 5% EV/sales sanity check. Net cash and shares at the horizon are stated directly (net_debt_horizon, shares.horizon) because the engine's FCFF would treat GAAP SBC as cash. SBC is counted once: via share-count dilution to the horizon (+5%) and via GAAP margins in the post-horizon success states.

The engine median ($21.69) and my ladder median (~$22) are higher because the base (+100% on custom legs, +4 EV/sales turns) and bull (+360%, +20 turns) scenarios encode the market's speculative premium on the computing option persisting partly over 12 months. The bear scenario (~$11.5) is intrinsic value.
